name: Kuzma Semyonov
source:
"I just don't wanna go now being... Being the most insufferable person here~!"

Perceived as annoying by most, Kuzma is often loud and teasing towards everyone else in the castle. It is not uncommon for him to be seen pestering his fellow participants, but this isn't with any malicious intent, for he doesn't truly want them to dislike him.

His contributions typically come in the form of witty remarks and joking comments, sometimes even about his own misfortune. Whether sudden or just plain inappropriate, he tends to catch the others off guard with his sense of humor.

Overall, he gives off playful, mischievous energy, though he certainly does have a kinder, more understanding side, as is demonstrated by the way he handles his roommate.

[From [url=https://crimsonsugarstudio.wixsite.com/crimson-sugar-studio/meet-the-cast]Crimson Sugar Studio website[/url]]
